title: Twenty, a Hundred, and the Nine Words That Are Not Here
label: ch:ur-round-amounts
canDo: I can count aloud, say twenty and a hundred, and say why Urdu's eleven to nineteen are nine separate words rather than a rule.

payoff.summary: The two round amounts a price actually names, the pair a noisy counter confuses, and an explicit account of what the teens cost and why they wait.
